lines: ① Lying down, rock knees side to side × 10.
③ Warm shower, then a 5-min walk.

caption:
7am, and Koko shuffles to the kettle feeling 30 years older than last night.

Morning back stiffness is really common. You've barely moved for hours, and discs take on a little fluid overnight. Movement warms tissues up, which is why most people loosen up within half an hour.

Hybi's 1-minute morning routine: in bed, rock your knees side to side × 10 and do pelvic tilts × 10, then a warm shower and a 5-minute walk. Go easy on heavy lifting in the first hour.

Stiffness lasting well over 30 minutes most mornings, waking you in the early hours, or coming with fever or weight loss deserves a GP check. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio combine hands-on care with simple exercises. Book online via the link in bio 🐨
